files.operation: Remove an internal reviewer identifier from metadata; retain the review artifact, review scope, all source bindings, and all scientific values unchanged.

original_manifest_semantics: Nested source manifests are exact historical copies binding the reviewed pre-projection inputs. COPY_BINDINGS.json records their correspondence to current public files. The root MANIFEST.json governs the publishable payload.
public_reproduction_limit: The removed internal identifier is not recoverable from this packet. All other values in the projected JSON were verified unchanged during local assembly.
